note: ADR-0058's fourth derived value, the operator's decision of 2026-10-19: who the description says reads the application, shown in Jobs as Who reads. These are the roles a person writing in the first person names ('I'm the CTO', 'I'm the hiring manager') that make a posting a founder's or an engineer's. Configuration, not code, because ADR-0031's audit reads several of these words as seniority words, which no module may hard-code. Each role is matched whole, its words separated by any space, a plural s allowed. The labels themselves, and the patterns for an agency, a recruiter and a named person, are in src/description.py. A change here re-reads every saved posting (src/facts.py).
